descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S15 Time to a settled list: search and re-sort on 50+ patients per context

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given 50+ Hospital patients and 50+ Nursing Home residents (the bulk data set: 52 per context)

When Search a single name, clear, then switch sort room → name → status, in each context

Then Each action ends in a settled list; the time from the last keystroke or sort change to the settled list is recorded per action

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Our own addition: neither the UAT nor the ticket sets a time (Q11). Timings are recorded as data for Daniela, not judged; 50+ per context is enough (Quinn 2026-10-14). Correctness of the settled list is judged by S12–S14

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (not-testable)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S15
